findings.identity: Original source head, torso and both holding hands move as one upper-body affine group.
findings.legs: Thigh/shin joint motion comes from fixed-length two-bone IK; shoes have independent pitch and declared sole targets. Knee/ankle pixels are continuously sampled from each original full-leg texture.
findings.walk: Near leg supports frames00-03; far leg supports04-07. Opposite contacts00/04 and alternating foot lift remain visible at fixed63px source scale.
findings.surface: Shared source hip-root rows follow the exact upperBody matrix, then blend continuously into the existing three-bone source skin. No sampled material caps rendered. Previous far-hip transparent strip is closed in walk00/walk06/idle01 details and reviewed63px playback. Folded inner joint skin uses explicit painter-order self-occlusion; no inverse-warp fold-zero claim.
findings.grip: All18 handGrip values exactly equal the same upperBody matrix applied to locked primary source C[251.5625,305.2].
findings.scale: Every frame retains the same512 logical source canvas, foot[256,435.2], pivot[.5,.85] and source-group scale.

independentHipReview.findings: Far-hip transparent strip removed; cream root to mint leg and upper-body edge continuous. Knee/ankle continuity retained.

visualReview.limitation: Hip centers are inferred under the source hand/pelvis occlusion; this remains a locally rigged candidate awaiting main-session renderer review.

limitations: Only front_right produced; no front rotation substituted for back_right.

Hip centers remain inferred under hand/pelvis occlusion. Real source leg-root pixels follow the upperBody at the shared boundary and continuously blend to existing thigh/shin/foot transforms. No material-sampled hip cap is rendered.
